basic_info.description: Thoughtfully renovated and flooded with natural light, this exceptional single-family home offers sweeping views of the Pacific and a flexible layout for modern living. The main level features 2 spacious bedrooms and a tastefully updated bathroom, while the lower level offers a generous bonus room and 2nd full bath with kitchenette - perfect as a third bedroom, guest suite, or rental opportunity.   The fully remodeled chef's kitchen showcases quartz countertops, abundant cabinetry, a gas range, and stainless steel appliances, all seamlessly connected to the open-concept dining and living areas  ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The main bathroom is enhanced by a skylight and elegant finishes, while both upstairs bedrooms overlook the tranquil backyard.  Additional highlights include a spacious two-car side-by-side garage, driveway parking for two more vehicles, a Nest thermostat, Ring doorbell, and custom lighting throughout the home.   Just one block from Merced Heights Playground & Dog Park, and minutes from scenic Brooks Park. Enjoy close proximity to shops and dining at Stonestown Galleria and Ocean Ave, public transit, and easy freeway access. This home truly checks every box!
